title: FAI Orchard Pollinations Graph
description: The bidirectional link graph between Solution Accelerators (in this Orchard) and FrootAI Solution Plays (in frootai/solution-plays/). Flat edge-list shape — one row per relationship — so consumers can group either direction without rewriting the file. Auto-populated by enrich.js (Phase [A2.5]), extended via community PRs (Phase [A2.25] hand-seeds the first 50 manual edges). Schema is CC0-1.0; adopt freely. See planning/fai-orchard-masterplan.md §S for the conceptual model.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0 (Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal — public domain dedication). SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0. Authored by FrootAI 2026-05-25 as part of Phase [A0.9] of the FAI Orchard master plan.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the schema this document validates against. Conventionally https://frootai.dev/schemas/orchard-pollinations.v1.json.

schema_version.description: Strict semver of this schema (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). v1.0.0 is the initial release.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When the file was last regenerated by the pipeline (or hand-edited).

comment.description: Free-form note about this file revision. Useful for hand-edited revisions.

edges.description: One edge per (accelerator, play, relation) triple. Empty array is valid (initial state until enrich.js or community PRs populate it). Order is not significant.

accelerator_id.description: Canonical Accelerator id from fai-accelerator.schema.json (lowercase, double-underscore separator).

play_id.description: Two- or three-digit zero-padded Solution Play ID (01-999). Three-digit supports v2.0 100-play expansion.

play_slug.description: Optional Play slug for stable URLs and human-readable IDs: <id>-<kebab-name>. Example: '01-enterprise-rag'.

relation.description: How the Accelerator relates to the Play. baseline=simpler starter; extends_to=Play builds on top; alternative=different stack same outcome; uses_pattern=shares architectural pattern; provides_infra=cultivated infra layer.

confidence.description: How sure we are this edge is correct. 1.0 = manually verified; 0.95+ = LLM with explicit reasoning; 0.7-0.95 = LLM auto-suggest; <0.7 = rejected at bundle time.

reason.description: Why this edge exists. Required quality bar for community PRs (≤500 chars).

source.description: Edge provenance. auto=enrich.js LLM suggestion; manual=hand-added by FrootAI; community_pr=external contributor.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When this edge was added.

added_by.description: Pipeline identifier OR GitHub username. Examples: 'fai-enrich-pollination-suggester/v1.0', 'github:pavle'.

examples.comment: Phase [A0.9] starter — empty edges array. First 50 manual edges land in [A2.25].
